summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K on April 30, 2026, disclosing its total voting rights and issued share capital under UK Financial Conduct Authority Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. As of that date, it has 2,521,242,327 ordinary shares with one vote each, no treasury shares, and this denominator is for shareholder notification obligations. This is a routine regulatory report of share capital and voting rights, not a special situation. No deal terms or structural changes are involved.
